title: dryopteris paucijuga
intro: Dryopteris paucijuga, commonly known as the few-jointed shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris paucijuga include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
